name: Oakton Barber Shop
about: A neighborhood barbershop on Chain Bridge Road in Oakton. Customers praise the careful, well-balanced cuts, fair pricing, and a staff that greets everyone who walks in.
locationNote: Walk-ins welcome · Call ahead on busy days

reviews.author: George B.
reviews.text: Then walk out with what could be the best haircut in the DMV. Good, clean, old fashioned service, well managed, with fair pricing, and run by quality oriented staff.

reviews.author: Oliver C.
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for 3 years now, and it’s definitely for a reason. The staff here is nothing but nice, they’re always willing to have conversations.

reviews.author: Vince T.
reviews.text: At the end, he made sure I liked all the angles and even gave me a hot towel and nice massage. Would definitely recommend.
